orbit.texts.native_load_failed.title: Orbit - Failed to Load Native Libraries
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.advanced_: If you understand the risks, you can skip the integrity check by adding the following property to your JVM arguments: -Dorbit.disableIntegrityCheck=true
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.report: If none of the above works, please open a report on Orbit's issue tracker on GitHub.
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.unsupport: Orbit doesn't support this platform. It currently runs on 64-bit Windows, 64-bit Linux and Apple Silicon Macs.
Orbit can't run on this system, so you'll need to remove it from your mods folder.
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.ultraligh: Orbit couldn't download the Ultralight libraries it needs.
Check your internet connection and relaunch the game. If you're behind a firewall or proxy, make sure the game is allowed to access the internet.
Orbit couldn't verify that all of the required Ultralight native libraries were genuine, so they weren't loaded. This can happen if the libraries were modified or corrupted in some way.
Relaunch the game. If it keeps happening, delete Orbit and the contents of its folder, then download and install a fresh copy of the mod from an official source.
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.jni_bridg: Orbit's JNI bridge native library is missing from this copy of the mod.
Download and install a fresh copy of the mod from an official source.
Orbit couldn't verify that its JNI bridge native library was genuine, so it was not loaded. This can happen if the library was modified or corrupted in some way.
Relaunch the game. If it keeps happening, delete Orbit and the contents of its folder, then download and install a fresh copy of the mod from an official source.
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.integrity: Orbit couldn't reach GitHub to verify that its native libraries were genuine, so they weren't loaded.
Check your internet connection and relaunch the game.
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.native_lo: A native library required by Orbit couldn't be loaded.
Relaunch the game. If it keeps happening, check the game log for details.
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.unknown.d: Something went wrong while loading Orbit's native libraries.
orbit.texts.native_load_failed.unknown.f: Relaunch the game. If it keeps happening, check the game log for details.
